field_evidence.definition: ASB is behaviour causing or likely to cause harassment, alarm or distress to persons outside the same household.
field_evidence.classification_summary: MPS classifies ASB under 13 headings and qualifies incidents as Personal, Nuisance, and Environmental.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the Metropolitan Police Service MPS AntiSocialBehaviour dataset, classifying ASB into Personal, Nuisance and Environmental qualifiers and exposing a ward field in the official CSV resource M2045_MPS_Antisocial_Behaviour.csv for May 2025 through April 2026. This batch binds the already verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that previously unused official public dataset; ward-row extraction, geometry and parcel spatial join remain deferred to local OpenCode.
